House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money to the Metropolitan Council for grants to implementing agencies to manage aquatic invasive species.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; METROPOLITAN COUNCIL AQUATIC INVASIVE SPECIES GRANTS. +]

[+$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Metropolitan Council for grants to implementing agencies of the Metropolitan Council regional parks system for initiatives to reduce the spread of aquatic invasive species. This appropriation may be used for prevention, containment, control, and enforcement for managing aquatic invasive species. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money to the Metropolitan Council for grants to implementing agencies to manage aquatic invasive species.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; METROPOLITAN COUNCIL AQUATIC INVASIVE SPECIES GRANTS.

$1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Metropolitan Council for grants to implementing agencies of the Metropolitan Council regional parks system for initiatives to reduce the spread of aquatic invasive species. This appropriation may be used for prevention, containment, control, and enforcement for managing aquatic invasive species. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2027.
